children: ) announced on Wednesday that its board of directors has approved a $2B increase to the share repurchase program, raising the total authorization since July 2011 to $20B, with no expiration date for the program.
Under the company’s previously authorized $18B share repurchase program, approximately $0.6B in repurchase authority remained at the end of the second quarter of 2026.
The company said it may continue to repurchase shares from time to time in the open market or in other privately negotiated transactions, subject to market conditions.

title: Motorola Solutions expands share repurchase program by $2B
